objects.description: No custom types are defined in this header. It only contains include guards, preprocessor configuration macros for MAVLink, and includes of other headers (version.h, common.h) where actual type definitions likely reside.

Old-style packed 4-byte parameter union with a type tag. Carries a parameter value in one of several 1/2/4-byte scalar forms or raw bytes plus a type discriminator. Used for transmitting parameters without conversion.

New-style packed 8-byte parameter union supporting either a double (when is_double=1) or various smaller types indicated by mavlink_type. The union is treated as little-endian and 8-byte aligned for field ordering concerns.
Packed struct holding the current system and component IDs used by MAVLink convenience send functions.
Packed in-memory representation of a MAVLink frame, including header fields, 24-bit msgid, payload storage, checksum bytes, and optional signature block.

objects.definition:
typedef enum {
	MAVLINK_TYPE_CHAR     = 0,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_UINT8_T  = 1,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_INT8_T   = 2,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_UINT16_T = 3,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_INT16_T  = 4,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_UINT32_T = 5,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_INT32_T  = 6,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_UINT64_T = 7,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_INT64_T  = 8,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_FLOAT    = 9,
	MAVLINK_TYPE_DOUBLE   = 10
} mavlink_message_type_t;
objects.description: Enumeration of supported MAVLink field base types for message definition metadata.
Metadata description for a single field within a MAVLink message, including name, print format, type, array length, and offsets.
Holds metadata about a MAVLink message type: its ID, name, number of fields, and the ordered list of field descriptors.
Enumeration of logical MAVLink communication channels. Note: The typedef is guarded by HAVE_MAVLINK_CHANNEL_T; if that macro is defined elsewhere, this definition is omitted.

objects.definition:
typedef enum {
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_UNINIT=0,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_IDLE,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_STX,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_LENGTH,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_INCOMPAT_FLAGS,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_COMPAT_FLAGS,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_SEQ,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_SYSID,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_COMPID,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_MSGID1,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_MSGID2,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_MSGID3,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_PAYLOAD,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_CRC1,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_GOT_BAD_CRC1,
    MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_SIGNATURE_WAIT
} mavlink_parse_state_t; ///< The state machine for the comm parser
objects.description: Enumeration of parser states used during MAVLink frame parsing.
Enumeration describing the outcome of parsing a MAVLink frame: incomplete, OK, bad CRC, or bad signature.

objects.definition:
typedef struct __mavlink_status {
    uint8_t msg_received;               ///< Number of received messages
    uint8_t buffer_overrun;             ///< Number of buffer overruns
    uint8_t parse_error;                ///< Number of parse errors
    mavlink_parse_state_t parse_state;  ///< Parsing state machine
    uint8_t packet_idx;                 ///< Index in current packet
    uint8_t current_rx_seq;             ///< Sequence number of last packet received
    uint8_t current_tx_seq;             ///< Sequence number of last packet sent
    uint16_t packet_rx_success_count;   ///< Received packets
    uint16_t packet_rx_drop_count;      ///< Number of packet drops
    uint8_t flags;                      ///< MAVLINK_STATUS_FLAG_*
    uint8_t signature_wait;             ///< number of signature bytes left to receive
    struct __mavlink_signing *signing;  ///< optional signing state
    struct __mavlink_signing_streams *signing_streams; ///< global record of stream timestamps
} mavlink_status_t;
objects.description: Parser/channel status record tracking counters, state, sequencing, flags, signature progress, and pointers to signing state and streams.
Function pointer typedef for a callback that decides whether to accept unsigned packets for a given status and message ID.
Enumeration of possible outcomes/status codes from MAVLink signing operations.
Per-channel signing state, including flags, link ID, last timestamp, 32-byte secret key, a callback to accept unsigned packets, and last status result.
Holds timestamp state for multiple logical signing streams, keyed by link/system/component, used to prevent replay and manage signature time windows.
Table entry describing a MAVLink message type for dispatch/validation: msgid, CRC extra, min/max lengths, flags, and offsets of target fields if present.

16-bit unsigned integer type from stdint.h. This header defines functions that operate on uint16_t values used as CRC accumulators, but it does not define the type itself. Included here only to note that no custom types are introduced in this header.

SHA-256 context used by the MAVLink-specific implementation. Holds bit length (sz), the 8-word hash state (counter), and a 64-byte working buffer (u) used during block processing. Initialize with mavlink_sha256_init, feed data with mavlink_sha256_update, and finalize a 48-bit truncated digest with mavlink_sha256_final_48. The struct is plain-old-data and can be stack- or heap-allocated; it must be zero/initialized via the provided init function before use.

Internal helper union that allows treating a 1–32 bit field as various integer widths during packing/unpacking. Primarily used for bitfield operations in MAVLink serialization helpers within this header.

functions.name: mavlink_quaternion_to_dcm
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_quaternion_to_dcm(const float quaternion[4], float dcm[3][3])
functions.description: Converts a quaternion to a 3x3 rotation matrix (DCM). Input quaternion must be ordered as [w, x, y, z] (null rotation 1 0 0 0). Writes the resulting rotation matrix to dcm.
requirements: quaternion must point to at least 4 readable floats, ordered [w, x, y, z].
dcm must point to a writable 3x3 float array (at least 9 floats).
Pointers must be non-null and valid for the duration of the call.
Quaternion values should be finite; normalization is not enforced by the function but a normalized quaternion is expected for a proper rotation matrix (inferred).

functions.name: mavlink_dcm_to_euler
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_dcm_to_euler(const float dcm[3][3], float* roll, float* pitch, float* yaw)
functions.description: Converts a 3x3 rotation matrix (DCM) to ZYX Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) in radians. Handles near-singularities at ±pi/2 pitch with a special case.
requirements: dcm must point to a readable 3x3 float array (at least 9 floats) representing a rotation matrix.
roll, pitch, and yaw must be non-null pointers to writable floats.
Angles are returned in radians.
Input matrix should be a valid rotation matrix (orthonormal with determinant +1) for meaningful results (inferred).
All input values should be finite.

functions.name: mavlink_quaternion_to_euler
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_quaternion_to_euler(const float quaternion[4], float* roll, float* pitch, float* yaw)
functions.description: Converts a quaternion to ZYX Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) in radians. Internally converts the quaternion to a DCM, then to Euler angles. Quaternion must be ordered [w, x, y, z].
requirements: quaternion must point to at least 4 readable floats, ordered [w, x, y, z].
roll, pitch, and yaw must be non-null pointers to writable floats.
Angles are returned in radians.
Quaternion values should be finite; a normalized quaternion is expected for correct results (inferred).

functions.name: mavlink_euler_to_quaternion
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_euler_to_quaternion(float roll, float pitch, float yaw, float quaternion[4])
functions.description: Converts ZYX Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) in radians to a quaternion ordered [w, x, y, z].
requirements: roll, pitch, yaw must be finite floats in radians.
quaternion must point to a writable array of at least 4 floats to receive [w, x, y, z].
Pointer must be non-null and valid for the duration of the call.

functions.name: mavlink_dcm_to_quaternion
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_dcm_to_quaternion(const float dcm[3][3], float quaternion[4])
functions.description: Converts a 3x3 rotation matrix (DCM) to a quaternion ordered [w, x, y, z]. Uses a numerically stable method based on the matrix trace and the largest diagonal element.
requirements: dcm must point to a readable 3x3 float array (at least 9 floats) representing a rotation matrix.
quaternion must point to a writable array of at least 4 floats for [w, x, y, z].
Pointers must be non-null and valid for the duration of the call.
Input matrix should be a valid rotation matrix (orthonormal with determinant +1) for meaningful results (inferred).
All input values should be finite.

functions.name: mavlink_euler_to_dcm
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_euler_to_dcm(float roll, float pitch, float yaw, float dcm[3][3])
functions.description: Converts ZYX Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) in radians to a 3x3 rotation matrix (DCM).
requirements: roll, pitch, yaw must be finite floats in radians.
dcm must point to a writable 3x3 float array (at least 9 floats).
Pointer must be non-null and valid for the duration of the call.

functions.name: crc_accumulate
functions.signature: static inline void crc_accumulate(uint8_t data, uint16_t *crcAccum)
functions.description: Accumulates one byte into an ongoing CRC16_MCRF4XX (X.25) checksum. Intended to be called repeatedly for streaming data or per-byte updates. Note: This definition is compiled only if HAVE_CRC_ACCUMULATE is not defined; otherwise another implementation must be provided.
requirements: crcAccum must be a non-null pointer to writable uint16_t memory.
If starting a new checksum, *crcAccum should be initialized (typically via crc_init) before the first call.
data may be any 8-bit value (0–255).
The memory referenced by crcAccum must remain valid and exclusive during the call (do not share the same accumulator concurrently without synchronization).
If HAVE_CRC_ACCUMULATE is defined at compile time, this inline definition is not available; ensure a compatible implementation is supplied.

functions.name: crc_init
functions.signature: static inline void crc_init(uint16_t* crcAccum)
functions.description: Initializes a CRC accumulator to the X25/MCRF4XX initial value (0xFFFF) to begin a new CRC16 computation.
requirements: crcAccum must be a non-null pointer to writable uint16_t memory.
Call this before the first accumulation when starting a new checksum.

functions.name: crc_calculate
functions.signature: static inline uint16_t crc_calculate(const uint8_t* pBuffer, uint16_t length)
functions.description: Computes the CRC16_MCRF4XX (X.25) checksum over a contiguous buffer of bytes in one call. Internally initializes a local accumulator, processes length bytes, and returns the resulting CRC.
requirements: If length > 0, pBuffer must be a non-null pointer to at least length bytes of readable memory.
length may be zero; in that case, the return value is the CRC of an empty buffer (same as the initialized accumulator).

functions.name: crc_accumulate_buffer
functions.signature: static inline void crc_accumulate_buffer(uint16_t *crcAccum, const char *pBuffer, uint16_t length)
functions.description: Accumulates a sequence of bytes into an existing CRC16_MCRF4XX (X.25) accumulator. Useful for processing data in chunks while maintaining a running CRC.
requirements: crcAccum must be a non-null pointer to writable uint16_t memory holding the current CRC value (initialize via crc_init when starting a new checksum).
If length > 0, pBuffer must be a non-null pointer to at least length bytes of readable memory.
length may be zero, in which case the accumulator is unchanged.
Note: pBuffer is char*, but bytes are processed as unsigned (uint8_t) internally; ensure the buffer contains raw byte data of the intended content.

functions.name: mavlink::mavlink_sha256_init
functions.signature: void mavlink::mavlink_sha256_init(mavlink_sha256_ctx *m)
functions.description: Initialize a SHA-256 context for MAVLink. Sets the bit-length counters to zero and seeds the internal state (counter) to the standard SHA-256 initial values. Call this before feeding any data with mavlink_sha256_update and before producing a digest with mavlink_sha256_final_48. Note: The actual namespace is present only if MAVLINK_USE_CXX_NAMESPACE is defined when including this header.
requirements: m must be a valid, non-null pointer to a writable mavlink_sha256_ctx.
Must be called before any calls to mavlink_sha256_update or mavlink_sha256_final_48 on the same context.
The caller must ensure mavlink_sha256_ctx is zeroed/allocated appropriately; this function sets all necessary fields.

functions.name: mavlink::mavlink_sha256_update
functions.signature: void mavlink::mavlink_sha256_update(mavlink_sha256_ctx *m, const void *v, uint32_t len)
functions.description: Incrementally update the SHA-256 context with len bytes of input at v. Can be called multiple times to process data in chunks. Handles buffering and block processing internally, maintaining a 64-bit total bit count in the context.
requirements: m must be a valid, non-null pointer to an initialized mavlink_sha256_ctx (initialized via mavlink_sha256_init).
If len > 0, v must be a valid pointer to at least len bytes of readable memory; if len == 0, v may be null.
len is the number of bytes to process and may be any 32-bit unsigned value; processing updates the internal state and buffered block.
This function mutates the context and is not reentrant for the same context; do not use the same mavlink_sha256_ctx concurrently from multiple threads without external synchronization.
It is valid to call this function multiple times; the total message length is tracked internally.

functions.name: mavlink::mavlink_sha256_final_48
functions.signature: void mavlink::mavlink_sha256_final_48(mavlink_sha256_ctx *m, uint8_t result[6])
functions.description: Finalize the SHA-256 computation for the current context and write the first 48 bits (6 bytes) of the resulting hash into result. This function performs SHA-256 padding and length encoding, updates the context with the final blocks, and extracts the top 6 bytes of the digest in an order consistent with taking the first 6 bytes from conventional SHA-256 implementations. The extraction assumes little-endian ordering of the internal state words.
requirements: m must be a valid, non-null pointer to a mavlink_sha256_ctx previously initialized with mavlink_sha256_init and updated with zero or more calls to mavlink_sha256_update.
result must be a valid, non-null pointer to a writable buffer of at least 6 bytes.
After this call, the context reflects a finalized hash state; to hash new data, reinitialize the context with mavlink_sha256_init before further use.
Output byte ordering assumes little-endian representation of m->counter; cross-platform callers should be aware if targeting big-endian systems.

functions.name: mavlink_get_channel_status
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER mavlink_status_t* mavlink_get_channel_status(uint8_t chan)
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the per-channel mavlink_status_t for the specified channel. Used internally to access parsing/tx state for a channel.
requirements: chan must index a valid channel: 0 <= chan < MAVLINK_COMM_NUM_BUFFERS (function returns &m_mavlink_status[chan]).
Caller must not assume the storage duration if MAVLINK_EXTERNAL_RX_STATUS is defined externally; otherwise it is a static array inside the function.
Returned pointer must not be used after underlying storage is invalidated by the application (when external).

functions.name: mavlink_get_channel_buffer
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER mavlink_message_t* mavlink_get_channel_buffer(uint8_t chan)
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the per-channel mavlink_message_t parsing buffer for the specified channel.
requirements: chan must index a valid channel: 0 <= chan < MAVLINK_COMM_NUM_BUFFERS (function returns &m_mavlink_buffer[chan]).
If MAVLINK_EXTERNAL_RX_BUFFER is defined, the buffer array must be defined externally by the application; otherwise a static array is used.

functions.name: mavlink_reset_channel_status
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_reset_channel_status(uint8_t chan)
functions.description: Resets the parse state of the specified channel to idle by setting parse_state to MAVLINK_PARSE_STATE_IDLE.
requirements: chan must refer to a valid channel for mavlink_get_channel_status.
This only resets parse_state; other status fields remain unchanged.

functions.name: mavlink_sign_packet
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t mavlink_sign_packet(mavlink_signing_t *signing, uint8_t signature[MAVLINK_SIGNATURE_BLOCK_LEN], const uint8_t *header, uint8_t header_len, const uint8_t *packet, uint8_t packet_len, const uint8_t crc[2])
functions.description: Builds a MAVLink 2 signature block for an outgoing packet using the provided signing context, header, payload, and checksum. On success fills the signature buffer and returns MAVLINK_SIGNATURE_BLOCK_LEN; returns 0 if signing is disabled or signing is NULL.
requirements: signing must be non-NULL and have MAVLINK_SIGNING_FLAG_SIGN_OUTGOING set to produce a signature (otherwise returns 0).
signature must point to a buffer of at least MAVLINK_SIGNATURE_BLOCK_LEN bytes.
header/header_len must describe the already-formed packet header bytes (including magic and header fields as used in checksum/signature).
packet/packet_len must point to the serialized payload bytes used in the checksum.
crc must point to two bytes containing the CRC on wire order (ck_a, ck_b).
Function increments signing->timestamp and embeds link_id and a 6-byte timestamp into the signature.

functions.name: _mav_trim_payload
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t _mav_trim_payload(const char *payload, uint8_t length)
functions.description: Trims trailing zero bytes from a serialized MAVLink 2 payload buffer and returns the trimmed length.
requirements: payload must point to at least 'length' bytes.
Only used for MAVLink 2 payload sizing; does not modify the buffer.

functions.name: mavlink_signature_check
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER bool mavlink_signature_check(mavlink_signing_t *signing, mavlink_signing_streams_t *signing_streams, const mavlink_message_t *msg)
functions.description: Verifies the MAVLink 2 signature of a received message against the provided signing key and stream state. Updates signing->last_status accordingly and enforces anti-replay using per-stream timestamps.
requirements: If signing is NULL the function returns true (signature not enforced).
msg must point to a received message whose signature bytes (msg->signature) and header/payload/CRC are intact.
signing must be non-NULL to perform checks; signing->secret_key is used, and signing->timestamp may be updated.
signing_streams must be non-NULL to pass; otherwise the function returns false and sets last_status to MAVLINK_SIGNING_STATUS_NO_STREAMS.
For new streams, the embedded timestamp must not be more than 1 minute older than signing->timestamp, otherwise verification fails with MAVLINK_SIGNING_STATUS_OLD_TIMESTAMP.
For known streams, the incoming timestamp must be strictly greater than the last stored timestamp to prevent replay (MAVLINK_SIGNING_STATUS_REPLAY on failure).

functions.name: mavlink_finalize_message_buffer
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint16_t mavlink_finalize_message_buffer(mavlink_message_t* msg, uint8_t system_id, uint8_t component_id, mavlink_status_t* status, uint8_t min_length, uint8_t length, uint8_t crc_extra)
functions.description: Finalizes a MAVLink message: sets header fields, trims payload for MAVLink 2, computes and writes checksum, optionally adds signing flags/signature, and returns the total on-wire length.
requirements: msg must contain msgid and payload bytes in _MAV_PAYLOAD(msg) already populated.
status must be a valid pointer providing current_tx_seq, flags, and optional signing context; it is updated (sequence incremented).
system_id and component_id are assigned to msg->sysid and msg->compid.
min_length must be the MAVLink v1 payload length for the message; length is the MAVLink v2 max payload length before trimming.
crc_extra must be the message’s extra CRC byte per definition.
If MAVLink 1 output is selected (status->flags & MAVLINK_STATUS_FLAG_OUT_MAVLINK1), messages with msgid > 255 are not supported by v1; caller must avoid such combinations.
If signing is enabled (non-MAVLink1 and status->signing with SIGN_OUTGOING), msg->incompat_flags is set and msg->signature is filled.

functions.name: mavlink_finalize_message_chan
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint16_t mavlink_finalize_message_chan(mavlink_message_t* msg, uint8_t system_id, uint8_t component_id, uint8_t chan, uint8_t min_length, uint8_t length, uint8_t crc_extra)
functions.description: Convenience wrapper that finalizes a MAVLink message using the status associated with a specific channel.
requirements: chan must be a valid channel index for mavlink_get_channel_status.
All requirements of mavlink_finalize_message_buffer apply.

functions.name: mavlink_finalize_message
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint16_t mavlink_finalize_message(mavlink_message_t* msg, uint8_t system_id, uint8_t component_id, uint8_t min_length, uint8_t length, uint8_t crc_extra)
functions.description: Finalizes a MAVLink message using MAVLINK_COMM_0 as the default channel.
requirements: Equivalent to mavlink_finalize_message_chan with chan = MAVLINK_COMM_0; all its requirements apply.

functions.name: _mav_finalize_message_chan_send
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void _mav_finalize_message_chan_send(mavlink_channel_t chan, uint32_t msgid, const char *packet, uint8_t min_length, uint8_t length, uint8_t crc_extra)
functions.description: Builds a MAVLink header for the given msgid and payload, computes checksum, optionally signs, and sends the bytes over the given channel using _mavlink_send_uart. More stack-efficient than packing a mavlink_message_t when sending.
requirements: Only available when MAVLINK_USE_CONVENIENCE_FUNCTIONS is defined.
chan must be a valid MAVLink channel for the platform’s send macros.
packet must point to a payload buffer of at least 'length' bytes (will be trimmed for MAVLink 2).
min_length must be the MAVLink v1 payload length for the message type; required when sending MAVLink 1.
If MAVLink 1 is active and msgid > 255, the function records a parse error and returns without sending.
crc_extra must match the message definition.
Platform must provide MAVLINK_START_UART_SEND, MAVLINK_END_UART_SEND, and either MAVLINK_SEND_UART_BYTES or comm_send_ch.

functions.name: _mavlink_resend_uart
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void _mavlink_resend_uart(mavlink_channel_t chan, const mavlink_message_t *msg)
functions.description: Re-sends an already-finalized MAVLink message structure over a UART channel without re-marshalling. Preserves the original signature if present.
requirements: Only available when MAVLINK_USE_CONVENIENCE_FUNCTIONS is defined.
msg must point to a fully formed mavlink_message_t with header fields, payload, checksum, and (if present) signature already set.
chan must be valid for the platform’s send macros.
Platform must provide MAVLINK_START_UART_SEND and MAVLINK_END_UART_SEND and either MAVLINK_SEND_UART_BYTES or comm_send_ch.

functions.name: mavlink_msg_to_send_buffer
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint16_t mavlink_msg_to_send_buffer(uint8_t *buf, const mavlink_message_t *msg)
functions.description: Serializes a finalized mavlink_message_t into a byte buffer in on-wire format (header, payload, checksum, and optional signature) and returns the total number of bytes written.
requirements: buf must be large enough to hold header + 1 (magic) + payload + 2 CRC bytes + optional signature.
msg must contain a valid magic, header fields, payload, and checksum; for MAVLink 2 the payload is trimmed before writing.
If msg->incompat_flags has MAVLINK_IFLAG_SIGNED set, MAVLINK_SIGNATURE_BLOCK_LEN bytes are copied after the CRC.

functions.name: mavlink_start_checksum
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_start_checksum(mavlink_message_t* msg)
functions.description: Initializes the checksum accumulator in the message (msg->checksum) to the CRC initial value before accumulating bytes.
requirements: msg must be non-NULL.
Call before accumulating header/payload bytes via mavlink_update_checksum or equivalent.

functions.name: mavlink_update_checksum
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_update_checksum(mavlink_message_t* msg, uint8_t c)
functions.description: Accumulates a single byte into the message checksum (msg->checksum).
requirements: msg must be non-NULL and its checksum field must have been initialized with mavlink_start_checksum before the first update.

functions.name: mavlink_get_msg_entry
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER const mavlink_msg_entry_t *mavlink_get_msg_entry(uint32_t msgid)
functions.description: Looks up the message definition entry (CRC extra, min/max lengths, etc.) for the given msgid using a bisection search over MAVLINK_MESSAGE_CRCS. Returns NULL if msgid is not found.
requirements: MAVLINK_MESSAGE_CRCS must be defined to a sorted array initializer by msgid at compile time.
msgid must correspond to a known MAVLink message for a non-NULL result.

functions.name: mavlink_get_crc_extra
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t mavlink_get_crc_extra(const mavlink_message_t *msg)
functions.description: Returns the crc_extra byte for the message’s msgid using mavlink_get_msg_entry, or 0 if msgid is unknown.
requirements: msg must be non-NULL and have msg->msgid set.
If the message id is not found in the table, 0 is returned.

functions.name: mavlink_min_message_length
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t mavlink_min_message_length(const mavlink_message_t *msg)
functions.description: Returns the minimum payload length for the message’s msgid from the message entry, or 0 if unknown.
requirements: msg must be non-NULL and have msg->msgid set.
If the message id is not found, returns 0.

functions.name: mavlink_max_message_length
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t mavlink_max_message_length(const mavlink_message_t *msg)
functions.description: Returns the maximum payload length (including extensions) for the message’s msgid from the message entry, or 0 if unknown.
requirements: msg must be non-NULL and have msg->msgid set.
If the message id is not found, returns 0.

functions.name: mavlink_frame_char_buffer
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t mavlink_frame_char_buffer(mavlink_message_t* rxmsg, mavlink_status_t* status, uint8_t c, mavlink_message_t* r_message, mavlink_status_t* r_mavlink_status)
functions.description: State-machine parser that consumes one input byte at a time using caller-supplied parsing buffers and emits a completed message when available. Returns a framing status: 0 (MAVLINK_FRAMING_INCOMPLETE), 1 (MAVLINK_FRAMING_OK), 2 (MAVLINK_FRAMING_BAD_CRC), or MAVLINK_FRAMING_BAD_SIGNATURE when applicable. Supports MAVLink 1 and 2, zero-fills missing extension bytes, and optional signature verification.
requirements: rxmsg and status must be valid pointers and persist across calls for a given stream.
c is a single incoming byte from the stream.
r_message may be NULL; if non-NULL, it is filled with a copy when a message completes.
r_mavlink_status may be NULL; if non-NULL, selected parsing status fields are copied out each call.
If message length does not match min/max (when MAVLINK_CHECK_MESSAGE_LENGTH is defined), parsing is aborted for that frame.

If a message has MAVLink 2 signature flag set, a full MAVLINK_SIGNATURE_BLOCK_LEN bytes must follow the CRC; signature is verified unless MAVLINK_NO_SIGNATURE_CHECK is defined or accept_unsigned_callback allows it.

functions.name: mavlink_frame_char
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t mavlink_frame_char(uint8_t chan, uint8_t c, mavlink_message_t* r_message, mavlink_status_t* r_mavlink_status)
functions.description: Convenience wrapper around mavlink_frame_char_buffer that uses internal per-channel buffers to parse an incoming byte stream for the given channel.
requirements: chan must be a valid channel index for mavlink_get_channel_buffer/status.
All requirements of mavlink_frame_char_buffer regarding r_message/r_mavlink_status apply.

functions.name: mavlink_set_proto_version
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void mavlink_set_proto_version(uint8_t chan, unsigned int version)
functions.description: Sets the outgoing protocol version for a channel: version > 1 selects MAVLink 2; otherwise MAVLink 1.
requirements: chan must be valid for mavlink_get_channel_status.
version > 1 will clear MAVLINK_STATUS_FLAG_OUT_MAVLINK1; version <= 1 will set it.

functions.name: mavlink_get_proto_version
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER unsigned int mavlink_get_proto_version(uint8_t chan)
functions.description: Returns the configured outgoing protocol version for a channel: 1 for MAVLink 1, 2 for MAVLink 2.
requirements: chan must be valid for mavlink_get_channel_status.

functions.name: mavlink_parse_char
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t mavlink_parse_char(uint8_t chan, uint8_t c, mavlink_message_t* r_message, mavlink_status_t* r_mavlink_status)
functions.description: Parses an incoming byte using channel-based buffers and returns 1 on a successfully decoded message with good CRC/signature, or 0 otherwise. On bad CRC/signature it resets the parser state and, if the byte was a start-of-frame, prepares for a new frame.
requirements: chan must be a valid channel index.
All requirements of mavlink_frame_char apply regarding r_message/r_mavlink_status.
Caller should treat a return value of 0 as no valid message decoded (including bad CRC/signature).

functions.name: put_bitfield_n_by_index
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER uint8_t put_bitfield_n_by_index(int32_t b, uint8_t bits, uint8_t packet_index, uint8_t bit_index, uint8_t* r_bit_index, uint8_t* buffer)
functions.description: Packs a value b into a bitfield of length 'bits' (1..32) at the specified bit offset within a packet buffer, updating r_bit_index and returning the number of bytes advanced from packet_index.
requirements: bits specifies the number of bits to encode; intended range is 1..32.
buffer must be non-NULL and large enough to contain the written bits starting at the specified indices.
r_bit_index must be non-NULL; it receives the final bit index within the last modified byte.
packet_index/bit_index locate the first bit position; bit_index is 0..7 for a new byte, or indicates remaining free bits in a partially filled byte.
Byte order/endianness handling follows MAVLINK_NEED_BYTE_SWAP configuration.

functions.name: _mavlink_send_uart
functions.signature: MAVLINK_HELPER void _mavlink_send_uart(mavlink_channel_t chan, const char *buf, uint16_t len)
functions.description: Platform abstraction to send len bytes from buf over the UART associated with chan. Uses MAVLINK_SEND_UART_BYTES if provided, otherwise sends one byte at a time via comm_send_ch.
requirements: Only available when MAVLINK_USE_CONVENIENCE_FUNCTIONS is defined.
Platform must define MAVLINK_SEND_UART_BYTES(chan, const uint8_t*, uint16_t) or comm_send_ch(mavlink_channel_t, uint8_t).
buf must point to at least len bytes; len may be 0.
